links.note: Was linked to 31271 'The rule' (distributivity a(b+c)=ab+ac). The item divides -7 by -10 to recover a missing factor; distributivity plays no part. The chapter's closed set has no concept for dividing rational numbers (31260 is only the not-closed-under-division fact), so there is nothing to move it to.
Was linked to 31271 'The rule' (distributivity). Same as qid 113424 - it divides 28/27 by -4/9 to find the other factor. No distributivity, and the set has no rational-division concept.

Was linked to 31269 'Zero is the additive identity'. The item needs the additive INVERSE of 11/18 (i.e. -11/18) and then a multiplication; identity and inverse are different ideas. The set has no additive-inverse concept, so there is nothing correct to move it to.

Was linked to 31253 'Negatives and the integers'. The item is about the reciprocal of a positive rational, which has nothing to do with the integers being introduced to solve x+18=5. The set has no reciprocal / multiplicative-inverse concept.
